app.title: Sketch Village
app.subtitle: Defend the village you drew yourselves

camera.title: Take a photo
camera.hint: Put the paper on the table, well lit and fully visible.
camera.error_unsupported: This browser can't use the camera.
camera.error_denied: Camera is blocked. Allow it in the browser.

bg.title: Remove the paper
bg.hint: Use the slider to choose how much paper disappears. Checkerboard = transparent.
bg.inside: Also erase paper inside the drawing

editor.name: Name
editor.author: Drawn by
editor.levels_hint: Each upgrade level has its own drawing. A missing level uses the previous drawing.
editor.slots_hint: Only the first drawing is needed. Draw the hero holding a sword, bow or magic wand too – the game shows it with that weapon.
editor.need_name_image: Name or first drawing is missing

catHint.hero: The main character. Give it skill points.
catHint.enemy: Monsters that attack from the caves.
catHint.townhall: Town hall in the village centre – 3 levels.
catHint.decoration: Trees, rocks, flowers for the map.
catHint.coin: Coins dropped by enemies. Each coin drawing has its own value.
catHint.weapon: Swords, bows, magic wands. Every drawn weapon is playable: set its kind, one or two hands and damage next to the drawing.
catHint.shield: Shields for the left hand – set how much damage they absorb.
catHint.armor: Armor for the body – set how much damage it absorbs.
catHint.chest: Treasure chest dropped by enemies – it holds a weapon.

import.error_not_json: This is not a game data file.
import.error_wrong_format: This is not a Sketch Village file.
import.error_newer_version: The file is from a newer version of the game.
import.error_generic: The file could not be loaded.

data.title: Save & load
data.export_hint: One file with all drawings, maps and settings. Take it to another computer.
data.import_hint: Adds drawings and maps from the file. Nothing is deleted; the newer version wins.
data.purge_hint: Download everything first, just in case.
data.confirm_purge_all: Really delete ALL drawings and maps? This can't be undone.
data.pack_hint: Drawings, maps and rules the teacher put on the website. Adds them to yours – nothing is deleted.
data.pack_none: The website has no class pack yet.
data.pack_teacher: For teachers: how to share with every computer
data.pack_howto: Download everything (button above), rename the file to default-data.json and replace public/default-data.json in the game's GitHub repository. After the website updates, every new computer starts with it, and others can press “Load class pack”.

maps.title: Maps
maps.empty: No maps yet. Paint a new one or start from the sample.
maps.name: Map name
maps.no_decorations: Draw some decorations in the Drawing studio first.
maps.decor_on_road: Decorations go on the grass, not on the road.
maps.hint_road: Yellow road – you can walk on it. Lead roads from the map edge to the centre.
maps.hint_grass: Green grass – nobody can walk on it. Works as an eraser for roads.
maps.hint_pencil: Draw decorations. Careful: a line across a road blocks it.
maps.hint_fill: Fill an area with one colour.
maps.hint_place_centre: Click where the town hall stands. It must be next to a road.
maps.hint_place_spot: Click next to a road – buildings will go here. Place as many as you like.
maps.hint_place_cave: Click near the map edge where a road ends. The cave snaps to the edge.
maps.hint_place_decoration: Pick a picture (trees, mountains…) and click on the green grass. Drag to move.
maps.hint_place_erase: Click the thing you want to remove.
maps.valid: The map is ready to play!
maps.problem_no_paths: There is no yellow road on the map.
maps.problem_centre_off_path: The town hall must be next to a road.
maps.problem_spot_far: Spot {{n}} is too far from a road.
maps.problem_cave_not_edge: Cave {{n}} must be on the map edge.
maps.problem_cave_off_path: Cave {{n}} is not next to a road.
maps.problem_cave_not_connected: No road leads from cave {{n}} to the town hall.
maps.problem_respawn_off_path: The hero start must be next to a road.

play.title: Play
play.no_maps: No map is ready. Create one under Maps.
play.no_heroes: No heroes – you'll play with a stick figure. Draw a hero in the Drawing studio.

game.hint: Click a road = walk · click an enemy = attack · drag = move view · wheel = zoom · 1/2/3 = sword/bow/magic · space = Ready
game.wobble: Pencil wobble – drawings move a little
game.ready_hint: Start the wave now – every second saved earns coins
game.msg_cant_hit: Flying enemies can only be hit with the bow (2)!
game.msg_hero_down: The hero fell! Back in {{s}} s.

build.ruin: Destroyed – build it again (from level 1) or clear the ruins.
build.th_sub: More health ({{hp}}) and buildings and hero can reach level {{n}}
build.th_heals: heals the hero standing next to it

weapons.title: Weapons
weapons.hint: Weapons add to the hero's attack. Sword-like ones hit up close, bows shoot, magic hurts everything around the target – even flying enemies. The hero finds them in chests from enemies or buys them in the town hall shop.
weapons.confirm_reset: Reset all weapons to the default ones?
weapons.empty: Nothing yet. Enemies sometimes drop a chest 🎁, and the town hall has a shop.
weapons.need_magic: Magic needs a magic weapon – find one in a chest or buy it at the town hall.
weapons.need_melee: You have no weapon for close combat.
weapons.reason_none: You have no weapon of this kind yet.
weapons.reason_switching: Wait – the hero is still changing weapons.
weapons.reason_twohand: Both hands hold a two-handed weapon.
weapons.starter: hero has it from the start
weapons.studio_hint: Weapons, shields and armor you draw in the Drawing studio are items too – their numbers are set there, next to the drawing.

enemies.title: Enemies
enemies.hint: Pick a drawing from the studio for each enemy and set its numbers. Changes apply to all maps.
enemies.confirm_reset: Reset all enemies to the default values? Your new enemies will be removed.
enemies.name: Name
enemies.color: Colour (used until there is a drawing)
enemies.confirm_delete: Delete enemy “{{name}}”? Waves that use it will skip it.

waves.title: Waves – {{map}}
waves.confirm_reset: Replace all rounds with the default 20 rounds?

tips.walk: Click the yellow road – your hero walks there.
tips.build: Click a dashed square next to the road to build. Start with a tower – it shoots arrows!
tips.ready: Ready? Press ⚑ Ready to call the wave early – you get bonus coins.
tips.fight: Click an enemy to attack it. ⚔️ sword is strong, 🏹 bow shoots from far away.
tips.coins: Enemies drop coins. Walk over them before they vanish!
tips.townhall: Click the town hall: upgrade it and make your hero stronger.
tips.bow: Flying enemies can only be hit with the bow – press 🏹 or key 2.

rules.title: Game rules
rules.hint: All the game's numbers: prices, health, tower power and more. Saved in the data file with everything else.
rules.confirm_reset: Reset all rules to the default values?
rules.townhall_hint: The town hall level limits how far buildings and the hero can be upgraded.
rules.hero_costs_hint: Bought at the town hall. Level N needs town hall level N.
rules.unlocks_hint: Something new after every wave. Round 1 = available from the start. The town hall level and coins still apply.
rules.hero_hint: Each hero spreads the skill points in the Drawing studio. Every Town Hall upgrade adds one more point to that stat.
rules.waves_note: Starting coins and prep times apply to maps without their own waves (waves are set per map).
rules.g_balance_heroHealRadius: Healing reach around the town hall
rules.g_balance_chestCoins: Coins from a chest when you have every weapon
rules.g_build_interactRadius: How close the hero must stand
